recommended_plan.summary: Migrate AvatarReX extracted raw data and all 19 reports to the existing private E: staging tree with resumable rsync; verify complete fingerprints; then retire only the exact cloud staging items after a new user authorization and deletion record.

alternatives.summary: Add at least 50 GiB persistent capacity; no data migration.
Add 20 GiB persistent capacity and conditionally delete only the live-reverified duplicate AvatarReX cloud archive.

execution_sequence_for_plan_c: Recheck formal guards, GPU/training process absence and current free bytes
Rehash both archive copies before any source action
Rsync extracted data and reports into migration_incoming with resume options
Verify counts, bytes, full content tree, path-size tree, key metadata and all report hashes
Publish incoming destination only after exact verification
Create and commit migration seal and deletion record
Request/confirm exact user authorization for the three source-retirement paths
Retire source paths one at a time and verify reclaimed capacity
Stop; formal training still requires its own preflight/execution task
hard_stop_conditions: Any source/destination byte, count or hash mismatch
Archive second copy absent or unhealthy
Any active process holding a candidate path
No explicit user selection and deletion authorization
